name: motion-haleness
description: A modern, high-contrast dark color theme for Visual Studio Code with semantic highlighting and a readable diff experience.

editor.fontFamily.default: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
editor.fontFamily.description: Monospace font family used in the editor. Motion Haleness bundles Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.

editor.fontWeight.description: Font weight used in the editor. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is a variable font (200-800); 300 keeps the code light and balanced.

terminal.integrated.fontFamily.default: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono, Menlo, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
terminal.integrated.fontFamily.description: Monospace font family used in the integrated terminal. Motion Haleness bundles Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.

terminal.integrated.fontWeight.description: Font weight used in the integrated terminal. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is a variable font (200-800); 300 keeps terminal output light and balanced.

markdown.preview.fontFamily.description: Font family used in the Markdown preview. Motion Haleness bundles Atkinson Hyperlegible; install it from the assets/fonts folder if it is not present on your system.
